title: Consumes / input formatters / action selection / 415
meaning: Input formatters read request bodies; unsupported or unreadable Content-Type can lead to 415 Unsupported Media Type.
[Consumes] can disambiguate otherwise identical routes by media type.
Custom IActionConstraint can implement specialized action matching, but [Consumes] is the normal attribute-level solution.
boundary_notes: 406/415 diagnostic customization, StatusCodePages and ProblemDetails are reserved for R03/P02.
R01 handles response/output negotiation, R02 handles request/input negotiation.
